name: LoadTenderBoard
tagline: Work every load down the routing guide – tender timers, auto-advance and spot fallback with acceptance KPIs in Power Apps.
description: A complete load-tendering app for shippers, 3PLs and brokers: tenders each load to the lane's routing-guide carriers in priority order with response-window countdowns, records accept / decline / expire with reasons, tenders the next carrier automatically, shortens the window for short-notice loads, re-tenders after carrier fall-offs and falls back to the spot market with quotes, a spot cap and a manager override. Overview KPIs show pickups at risk, first-tender and overall acceptance, spot share and premium; the carrier scorecard shows routing-guide compliance. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Routing-guide waterfall per load with rank, rate, sent / responded times, response time and outcome
Accept (late-acceptance confirmation), decline with reason codes, expire, withdraw
Auto-advance to the next carrier after a decline, expiry or fall-off
Spot-market fallback with quotes, premium vs budget, spot cap and manager override
Pickup-at-risk, expired, exhausted-guide and above-budget flags with a Needs action list
Loads list with bulk tender next / advance expired / assign, grouping by pickup day, carrier, customer
Tender board with drag and drop validated by the workflow rules
Carrier compliance scorecard: acceptance, primary-lane acceptance, declines, expiries, fall-offs, response time, spend
KPIs: first-tender and overall acceptance, waterfall depth, spot share and premium, committed spend vs budget
Roles: load planner, transport manager, analyst; history, tender log and undo
Power Fx outputs and events (NewRecordJson for every change), TenderCsv and SummaryJson
controlType: standard (two controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
